hero.title: Leaders and innovators from across media and technology
hero.description: Different roles, experience and perspectives at every gathering.

sections.heading: A community built across the industry.
sections.body: Attendees include executives, specialists, analysts, journalists and people from technology providers. They bring different experience and perspectives to each gathering.
These are among more than 300 companies represented at Media Collective events across broadcasting, streaming, studios, sports, entertainment and media technology.

faqs.question: Why is attendance curated?
faqs.answer: Attendance is curated to create a balanced mix of people with an interest in the event or its topic, while keeping each gathering relevant and useful.

faqs.question: Who attends Media Collective events?
faqs.answer: Our community includes people working across broadcasting, streaming, studios, sports, publishing and media technology.

faqs.question: How do I request an invitation?
faqs.answer: Most Media Collective events are invitation-led. You can request an invitation from the event page, and places are confirmed according to the event audience and available capacity.

faqs.question: How can my company partner with The Media Collective?
faqs.answer: We work with partners in different ways, from supporting an event to contributing experience, ideas or practical help.

faqs.question: Do you organise events for companies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Alongside our own programme, we can work with organisations on separate events where there is a good fit.

faqs.question: What types of events do you run?
faqs.answer: Our programme includes networking breakfasts, panel discussions, receptions and community gatherings across broadcasting, streaming and technology.
